title: Building a Modern Responsive Portfolio with CSS Subgrid & Container Queries
transcript:
In modern web design, your portfolio must be flawless across every screen size, from a 320px phone to an ultra-wide 4K monitor.
First: Stop using rigid media query breakpoints for every single element. Embrace modern CSS:
Use CSS Grid with subgrid for project cards. Subgrid ensures that project card headers, descriptions, tags, and action buttons align horizontally across columns regardless of content height differences.
Second: Container queries (@container). When a project card is displayed in a narrow sidebar or a bento slot, style it based on its container width, not the global viewport width.
Third: Fluid typography with clamp(). Use font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw + 1rem, 4.5rem) for hero titles so text scales smoothly without sudden jumpy media query breaks.
Fourth: Keep CSS clean and performant. Avoid massive bloated frameworks if you are just styling a portfolio. Clean semantic HTML + scoped CSS delivers a 100/100 Lighthouse performance score.
